item.description: i’m yet to find a problem that can survive moving closer to reality; if i'm stuck, i just start doing things. if i'm anxious, i switch thoughts for senses. if i'm worried about someone, i speak to them. we really do suffer more in imagination than in reality.
item.content:encoded:
@thejayalto

i’m yet to find a problem that can survive moving closer to reality; if i'm stuck, i just start doing things. if i'm anxious, i switch thoughts for senses. if i'm worried about someone, i speak to them. we really do suffer more in imagination than in reality.
